$comment: Reviewed, time-limited exceptions to the dependency-vulnerability gate.
An entry here means: 'this advisory affects us, we have assessed it, and we
have deliberately decided not to block on it yet.' Every entry is a debt
with an expiry date, not a permanent waiver.
2. An advisory WITH an available fix may not be listed here -- upgrade it.
3. An expired entry does not silently pass; it stops suppressing and the
build fails on that advisory again.
4. Admins are warned about malformed or expired entries on every run.
Keep this list short. If it grows, the real fix is a dependency upgrade or
removing the dependency, not another line here.
